blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has come up with guidelines in computing the amount of child support in cases where there is no written agreement or where adjustments are needed. The Guidelines on Fixing of Child Support, approved by the high court en banc on Nov. 6, complements the related rules under the Family Code of the Philippines and administrative orders concerning the recognition of foreign decisions on providing support for children. The Supreme Court, however, has yet to release a copy of the approved guidelines. The creation of the guidelines was triggered by concerns on the varying ways of […]...
